case_a_live_owner_commit.description: Run A claims, lease is alive, Run A commits

case_b_expired_owner_commit_before_recov.description: Run A claims, lease expires, Run A attempts commit before recover_expired_claims()

case_c_expired_owner_commit_after_recove.description: Run A claims, lease expires, recover_expired_claims() transitions to LEASE_EXPIRED_RECOVERABLE, Run A attempts commit

case_d_old_owner_commit_after_reclaim.description: Run A lease expires, Run B reclaims, Run A attempts commit

case_e_new_owner_commit.description: Run B validly reclaims and commits before lease expiry

case_f_committed_claim_rollback_rejectio.description: Attempt to rollback a claim already in COMMITTED state

case_g_committed_claim_recovery_rejectio.description: recover_expired_claims() never touches rows in COMMITTED state

case_h_abort_only_allowed_from_pending.description: rollback_claim only succeeds if claim_state == CLAIMED_PENDING_COMMIT
